parsed.post: Latest experiment (1.156338) performed worse than baseline (1.103305). It seems increasing complexity or changing the step size without warmup might be causing instability. Reverting to baseline. Next, I will test adding a small WARMUP_RATIO to stabilize the 0.08 learning rate.
parsed.description: Adding a warmup ratio of 0.05 to the baseline to see if it stabilizes the 0.08 learning rate and improves convergence.
